summary: Drafts prefilled GitHub issues for bugs or feedback about the azuresql-db skills or the Azure SQL container, submitting only after user confirmation.
whenToUse: Use when a user wants to report a bug or request a feature for these skills or the container, or the agent had to work around a skill defect.
flags: instructs the agent to proactively file bug reports when it deviates from the skills, even if the task succeeded
